source_manifest_reference: Complete bounded proposal text in the conversation

items.source_item: AUTOSAR Classic and Adaptive platform distinction
items.intent: Route vehicle software work to the appropriate platform architecture
items.rationale: The distinction is useful, but platform choice is separated from automatic safety classification and includes Foundation, exact release, project constraints and evidence.
items.verification_reference: Official AUTOSAR standards pages and Corp configuration baseline
items.follow_up_trigger: A real automotive project activates AUTOSAR scope

items.source_item: ARXML as a RAG knowledge base
items.intent: Use structured AUTOSAR model information for retrieval and analysis
items.rationale: ARXML is handled as a versioned schema/metamodel exchange model with secure XML parsing and semantic normalisation; RAG receives an authorised provenance-preserving graph view, not raw text chunks.
items.verification_reference: AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules and adapter review
items.follow_up_trigger: Approved schema, parser, fixtures and licence exist

items.source_item: GraphRAG links AUTOSAR to requirements, tests and safety goals
items.rationale: AI may propose links, but only explicit reviewed mappings with stable IDs, baselines, link types and evidence enter the controlled trace graph.
items.protected_outcome: Auditable traceability without inferred false links
items.follow_up_trigger: ALM and AUTOSAR model identifiers are available in an approved workspace

items.source_item: Presidio masks AUTOSAR signal, PDU, frame, address and calibration identifiers
items.intent: Prevent proprietary vehicle information from leaving an approved boundary
items.rationale: Identifiers are classified by project rather than universally treated as PII; external routes use stable semantic-preserving tokens and deterministic IP rules in addition to any PII detector.
items.protected_outcome: IP protection without destroying model semantics
items.verification_reference: AI processing envelope and adapter information-protection rules
items.follow_up_trigger: Representative automotive identifiers and an approved masking pilot exist

items.source_item: mask SecOC security keys before external AI use
items.rationale: Allowing raw cryptographic or production secrets to reach a masker or AI gateway creates avoidable disclosure risk; these values are hard-blocked and remain in controlled key-management or HSM processes.
items.verification_reference: Adapter prohibited-secret rule and future secret-scanning evidence
items.follow_up_trigger: Approved secret-detection and key-management integration is reviewed

items.source_item: Guardrails validates generated AUTOSAR output against metamodel and XML schema
items.intent: Prevent malformed or incompatible AUTOSAR artefacts from entering the toolchain
items.rationale: Guardrails may validate the response envelope; AUTOSAR correctness requires secure XML parsing, exact XSD, metamodel semantics, reference integrity, project/vendor validation and engineering tests.
items.follow_up_trigger: Approved AUTOSAR validation toolchain and negative fixtures exist

items.source_item: LLM-generated SW-Cs and RTE interfaces imported into AUTOSAR tools
items.rationale: Direct authoritative generation or import bypasses model ownership, configuration, generator qualification, semantic checks and safety/change impact. AI output is restricted to quarantined candidates; approved authoring and generation tools create controlled artefacts.
items.protected_outcome: Controlled generation, configuration and safety evidence
items.verification_reference: Adapter AI boundary and output-validation ladder
items.follow_up_trigger: A bounded candidate-generation use case has toolchain, fixtures, independent review and rollback

items.source_item: direct integration with Vector DaVinci, CANoe/vTESTstudio or dSPACE
items.intent: Connect AI-assisted analysis with the established automotive toolchain
items.rationale: Tool editions, licences, APIs, data boundaries, qualification impact, write permissions, fixtures and rollback are project-specific and not yet admitted.
items.follow_up_trigger: A named project and tool/version/API scope enters controlled capability intake
